output.framing: full-height 9:16 crop from the 4K source, centred on the subject and keyframed to follow it. Never letterbox a 16:9 frame into a vertical canvas.
output.note: Shorts are delivered at 1080x1920. The long-form 4K rule does not apply, but the crop is always taken from the 4K source so the image stays sharp.
output.colour: Phone footage is often HDR (HLG, 10-bit). Tone-map it to SDR (zscale + hable) and tag the output bt709, so the brand colours on the hook card display exactly.

captions.reason: Voiceless. The single hook card is the only on-screen text.

graphics.note: Short form raw: exactly one hook card, nothing else. No step cards, no stats.

audio.ambient_note: Ambient craft sound is kept only on real-time segments. Sped-up segments are music only.
audio.loudness_note: Shorts play in a feed next to louder videos, so the finished mix targets about -16 LUFS integrated (the long-form videos sit near -28 LUFS, which is too quiet for a feed). Measure the unprocessed mix, apply one static gain, and cap peaks with a limiter (auto-level off) so the encoded true peak stays under -1.4 dBFS. Judge the measured result, not the setting.
